item.title: Adam Sandler Said ‘Yes Right Away’ to Officiating Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s Wedding: ‘He Just Wanted to Speak From the Heart’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest celebrity news. Today, we're talking about a very special wedding that took place at Madison Square Garden, and the unexpected officiant who made it all happen.
[Short music transition]
Host: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce tied the knot in a star-studded ceremony, and who better to officiate the wedding than Adam Sandler? According to sources, Sandler was the perfect choice, given his 23-year marriage to his wife Jackie.
[Short music transition]
Host: A source close to the couple told People that Sandler was "incredibly honored" to be part of the special day and said "yes right away" when asked to officiate. And it seems he took his role very seriously, giving the couple some touching advice. According to Andy Reid, Kelce's coach, Sandler told the couple to "kiss every chance you have, every day."
[Short music transition]
Host: It's no surprise that Sandler was chosen for the role, given his experience with marriage and his connection to the couple. He shared screen time with Kelce on the set of Happy Gilmore 2, and the two seemed to bond over their sense of humor. Kelce even described Sandler as "every bit as cool off the screen as he is on the screen."
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in to our podcast, and we'll catch you on the next one.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
